{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient, as per data dictionary
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe').mean()

print(f"Deduplicated patient count: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Number with severe severity: {(df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe').sum()}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
